title: Naya Power North Star: Human Vision, AI Operational Burden
summary: Naya Power is a runtime architecture for making AI more reliable, verifiable, recoverable, useful, and human-friendly; the human supplies the goal while Naya carries the operational burden within legitimate authority.
what_happened: The North Star was clarified around ordinary humans accomplishing complicated missions without needing prompting expertise or technical orchestration skills.
what_we_learned: Lead is incomplete if the human must know what to ask next.
Human-Proof is incomplete if the human must run technical commands Naya can safely perform.
Evidence is incomplete if Naya can claim completion without proof.
Continuity is incomplete if critical mission state disappears between sessions.
why_it_matters: This gives every protocol a measurable purpose: reduce human operational burden while increasing truth, safety, execution quality, verification, continuity, and useful progress.
what_changed: Naya Power North Star is now treated as a runtime design requirement rather than a documentation aspiration.
next_best_action: Use the North Star as the acceptance test for every runtime capability and customer-facing protocol.
evidence: Explicit design decision recorded in 2026-08-23 Naya Power session
